cases.name: Courtney Owens
cases.about:
(Her mother) Andrea Owens, told Atlanta News First she hopes her daughter could be remembered as someone who had a "great impact on society."

"My daughter was an entrepreneur, she earned it, she worked hard, and she was a good girl," she said.
